mock_data.title: Gender Discrimination
mock_data.passage:
A major American bank is being sued by the US authorities for allegedly discriminating against its female employees. It has been alleged that women in the firm do not have as good promotion prospects as the men and that their salaries are not on a par with those of their male counterparts.

Gender discrimination in the workplace is against the law in America and in many other countries. However, there are still obstacles in many firms which prevent women from achieving the promotion that their talents and qualifications deserve. Many women are promoted quite rapidly through the junior jobs in a firm, but face the glass ceiling, when they apply for any of the most senior posts. So it is that, although there are many women in middle management positions in many firms, there are very few in top management posts.

chauvinists at heart, while some may feel that failure to promote women to top jobs is a result of feelings of insecurity in the men who are making the appointments. Perhaps they are afraid of letting women become too powerful.

Not many years ago the power which women have today would have seemed an impossible dream to many women. Before the rise of the women's movement there were no such things as equal rights or equal opportunities for women. For the most part, women were expected to get married and then be responsible for childcare and for carrying out all the household tasks. If they worked, it was probably in a part-time, often rather menial, job.

Feminists saw this as sexism and a waste of women's talents, and set out to change things. Although some people, women as well as men, now do not have a high regard for feminism, women owe to feminists many of the improvements in their work situation. Without them, there would be no positive discrimination, no job-sharing and no parity with men in the workplace.
mock_data.passageB1:
A big bank in America is being sued by the government. This means the government is taking them to court. They say the bank is discriminating against its female workers. The government believes women in the bank don't have the same chance for promotion as men. Also, their salaries are not as high as men's, even if they do the same job.

Gender discrimination at work is against the law in America and many other countries. But, in some companies, it is still hard for women to get promoted. Women might get promoted quickly in junior jobs. But, when they try to get senior positions, they face a problem. This problem is called the 'glass ceiling'. This means they can see the top jobs, but they can't reach them. So, many companies have women in middle management, but not many in top management.

It's hard to know why this happens. Some people think that some men don't want women to have power. They might be insecure and afraid of women becoming too powerful. They might think women shouldn't be in charge.

A long time ago, women didn't have the rights they have today. Before the women's movement, women were expected to get married and take care of children and the house. If they worked, it was usually in a part-time job that wasn't very important.

People who supported women's rights, called feminists, thought this was unfair and a waste of women's skills. They wanted to change things. Today, some people don't respect feminism. But women have many improvements at work because of feminists. For example, there is positive discrimination, which helps women get jobs. There is also job-sharing, where two people share one job. And there is parity, which means women and men should be treated equally at work.
mock_data.passageB2:
A major bank in the US is facing a lawsuit from American authorities, accused of discriminating against its female employees. The claim suggests women within the company don't have the same opportunities for advancement as their male colleagues, and their salaries are not comparable to men's for doing similar work. This situation highlights a persistent problem in the corporate world.

Gender discrimination in employment is illegal in many countries, including the US. However, many companies still have hidden barriers that prevent women from reaching promotions that match their skills and experience. Women often advance quickly in junior roles, but then encounter a 'glass ceiling' when applying for senior management positions. Consequently, while many women hold middle management roles, very few occupy top leadership positions. This disparity raises questions about the reasons behind it.

One possible explanation is that some male managers may hold unconscious biases. Some may believe, perhaps without realizing it, that men are better suited for leadership roles. Others might feel threatened by the prospect of women gaining too much power. These biases, whether conscious or unconscious, can hinder women's career progression.

It wasn't long ago that the level of power women have today seemed unimaginable. Before the rise of the women's movement, equal rights and opportunities were non-existent for women. Generally, women were expected to marry, raise children, and manage all household duties. If they worked, it was usually in a part-time, often low-skilled, job. This traditional view of women's roles significantly limited their potential in the workplace.

Feminists saw this as sexism and a waste of women’s potential, and they strived to change the situation. Although some people, both men and women, may now view feminism negatively, women owe many improvements in their working lives to feminists. Without their efforts, there would be no affirmative action policies, no job-sharing schemes, and no pay equity in the workplace. These advances represent significant progress towards a more equitable society, though more work remains to be done to eradicate gender discrimination completely.
mock_data.passageC1:
A prominent American financial institution is currently facing legal action initiated by federal authorities, the crux of the matter being alleged systemic discrimination against its female workforce. The accusations center on the assertion that women within the firm are stymied in their career progression, encountering diminished opportunities for advancement compared to their male colleagues. Furthermore, it is alleged that a significant disparity exists in remuneration, with women's salaries failing to achieve parity with those of men in equivalent roles.

While gender discrimination in professional settings is proscribed by law in the United States and numerous other nations, subtle yet pervasive obstacles continue to impede women's ascent to positions commensurate with their skills and experience. It is often the case that women experience relatively rapid advancement in junior roles, only to encounter the so-called 'glass ceiling' when vying for senior leadership positions. Consequently, despite a significant female presence in middle management across various industries, their representation in top-tier executive roles remains conspicuously low, a phenomenon that belies the strides made in other areas of gender equality.

The underlying reasons for this imbalance are multifaceted and complex. While some attribute it to entrenched, albeit often unconscious, biases among those responsible for making promotion decisions, others suggest that a degree of insecurity among male executives may factor into the equation. The apprehension that promoting women to positions of significant influence might somehow diminish their own power or status could be a contributing factor. It could also be argued that traditional gender stereotypes still exert an undue influence on perceptions of leadership potential.

It is worth recalling that the level of influence women wield today would have seemed unfathomable to many just a few decades ago. Prior to the rise of second-wave feminism, concepts such as equal rights and equal opportunities for women were largely absent from the societal discourse. Women were predominantly expected to prioritize marriage, childcare, and household management. If they engaged in paid employment, it was frequently confined to part-time, often menial, occupations.

Feminists of that era challenged what they perceived as pervasive sexism and a profound waste of women's capabilities, spearheading efforts to effect meaningful change. Although contemporary attitudes towards feminism are diverse, with some individuals, both male and female, expressing reservations, women undeniably owe many of the improvements in their professional lives to the efforts of these early activists. Without their advocacy, initiatives such as affirmative action, flexible work arrangements, and the pursuit of pay equity would likely not have gained the traction they have, thereby underscoring the enduring legacy of the feminist movement in the ongoing quest for gender equality in the workplace, and demonstrating that complacency is not an option.

mock_data.translation:
Yirik amerikalik bank AQSh organlari tomonidan o'z ayol xodimlariga nisbatan kamsitish qilgani uchun sudga berilmoqda. Da'vo qilinishicha, firmadagi ayollar erkaklar kabi yaxshi lavozimga ko'tarilish imkoniyatlariga ega emaslar va ularning maoshlari erkak hamkasblarining maoshlari bilan teng emas.

Ish joyida gender kamsitish Amerika va ko'plab boshqa mamlakatlarda qonunga ziddir. Biroq, ko'plab firmalarda hali ham ayollarning o'z iste'dodi va malakasiga loyiq lavozimga ko'tarilishiga to'sqinlik qiluvchi to'siqlar mavjud. Ko'plab ayollar firmadagi kichik lavozimlarda juda tez ko'tarilishadi, ammo eng yuqori lavozimlardan biriga ariza topshirganda shisha shift bilan duch kelishadi. Shunday qilib, ko'pgina firmalarda o'rta boshqaruv lavozimlarida ko'plab ayollar bo'lsa-da, yuqori boshqaruv lavozimlarida juda kam.

Ba'zilar yurakda shovinistlar, ba'zilari esa ayollarni yuqori lavozimlarga ko'tarmaslik tayinlovlarni amalga oshirayotgan erkaklardagi ishonchsizlik tuyg'ularining natijasi deb hisoblashlari mumkin. Ehtimol, ular ayollarning haddan tashqari kuchli bo'lishidan qo'rqishadi.

Ko'p yillar oldin ayollar bugungi kunda ega bo'lgan kuch ko'plab ayollarga imkonsiz orzu bo'lib tuyulgan bo'lardi. Ayollar harakati yuksalishidan oldin ayollar uchun teng huquqlar yoki teng imkoniyatlar kabi narsalar yo'q edi. Ko'pincha, ayollar turmush qurishlari va keyin bolalarga g'amxo'rlik qilish va barcha uy vazifalarini bajarish uchun javobgar bo'lishlari kutilgan edi. Agar ular ishlasalar, bu ehtimol qisman vaqtli, ko'pincha pastroq lavozimda edi.

Feministlar buni seksizm va ayollar iste'dodining isrofi deb ko'rdilar va narsalarni o'zgartirishga kirishdilar. Ba'zi odamlar, ayollar ham erkaklar ham, hozirda feminizmga yuqori hurmat ko'rsatmasalar ham, ayollar o'z ish vaziyatlaridagi ko'plab yaxshilanishlar uchun feministlarga qarzdorlar. Ularsiz ijobiy kamsitish, ish taqsimlash va ish joyida erkaklar bilan tenglik bo'lmaydi.

mock_data.translationB1:
Amerikadagi katta bank hukumat tomonidan sudga berilmoqda. Bu hukumat ularni sudga tortmoqda degani. Ularning aytishicha, bank o'zining ayol ishchilariga nisbatan kamsitish qilmoqda. Hukumat bankdagi ayollar erkaklar kabi lavozimga ko'tarilish imkoniyatiga ega emas deb hisoblaydi. Bundan tashqari, ularning maoshlari erkaklarniki kabi yuqori emas, hatto ular bir xil ishni qilsalar ham.

Ish joyida genderga oid kamsitish Amerika va boshqa ko'plab mamlakatlarda qonunga xilofdir. Ammo, ba'zi kompaniyalarda ayollarning lavozimga ko'tarilishi hali ham qiyin. Ayollar kichik lavozimlarda tezda ko'tarilishi mumkin. Ammo, ular yuqori lavozimlarni egallashga harakat qilsalar, muammoga duch kelishadi. Bu muammo "shisha shift" deb ataladi. Bu ular yuqori lavozimlarni ko'rishlari mumkin, ammo ularga erisha olmaydilar degani. Shunday qilib, ko'plab kompaniyalarda o'rta bo'g'in menejmentida ayollar bor, ammo yuqori menejmentda ularning soni kam.

Nima uchun bu sodir bo'lishini bilish qiyin. Ba'zi odamlar ba'zi erkaklar ayollarning hokimiyatga ega bo'lishini xohlamaydilar deb o'ylashadi. Ular ishonchsiz bo'lishi va ayollarning juda kuchli bo'lishidan qo'rqishlari mumkin. Ular ayollar boshqaruvda bo'lmasligi kerak deb o'ylashlari mumkin.

Qadim zamonlarda ayollar bugungi kunda ega bo'lgan huquqlarga ega emas edilar. Ayollar harakatidan oldin, ayollar turmushga chiqishlari va bolalar hamda uyga g'amxo'rlik qilishlari kutilgan edi. Agar ular ishlagan bo'lsalar, odatda unchalik muhim bo'lmagan to'liqsiz ishda ishlashgan.

Ayollar huquqlarini qo'llab-quvvatlovchi odamlar, feministlar, buni adolatsizlik va ayollarning mahoratini isrof qilish deb hisoblashdi. Ular vaziyatni o'zgartirishni xohlashdi. Bugungi kunda ba'zi odamlar feminizmga hurmat bilan qarashmaydi. Ammo ayollar feministlar tufayli ish joyida ko'plab yaxshilanishlarga erishdilar. Misol uchun, ayollarga ish topishga yordam beradigan ijobiy kamsitish mavjud. Shuningdek, bitta ishni ikki kishi bo'lishadigan ishni bo'lishish ham mavjud. Va tenglik ham bor, ya'ni ayollar va erkaklar ishda bir xil munosabatda bo'lishlari kerak.

AQShdagi yirik banklardan biri amerikalik rasmiylar tomonidan ayol xodimlariga nisbatan kamsitishda ayblanib, sudga tortilmoqda. Da'voga ko'ra, kompaniya ichidagi ayollarda erkak hamkasblari kabi martaba o'sishi uchun imkoniyatlar bir xil emas va ularning oyliklari shunga o'xshash ishni bajarish uchun erkaklar bilan taqqoslanadigan emas. Bu holat korporativ dunyodagi doimiy muammoni yoritib beradi.

Ko'pgina mamlakatlarda, shu jumladan AQShda ham, ish bilan ta'minlashda gender kamsitish noqonuniy hisoblanadi. Biroq, ko'plab kompaniyalarda ayollarning ko'nikmalari va tajribasiga mos keladigan lavozimlarga ko'tarilishiga to'sqinlik qiladigan yashirin to'siqlar mavjud. Ayollar ko'pincha quyi lavozimlarda tez o'sishadi, lekin keyin yuqori menejer lavozimlariga ariza berishda "shisha shiftga" duch kelishadi. Natijada, ko'plab ayollar o'rta menejer lavozimlarida ishlashsa-da, juda kamchiligi yuqori rahbariyat lavozimlarini egallaydi. Bu tafovut uning ortidagi sabablar haqida savollar tug'diradi.

Buning bir mumkin bo'lgan izohi shundaki, ba'zi erkak menejerlarda ong osti xurujlari bo'lishi mumkin. Ba'zilar, ehtimol buni anglamasdan, erkaklar rahbarlik lavozimlariga yaxshiroq mos keladi, deb hisoblashlari mumkin. Boshqalar ayollarning haddan tashqari ko'p hokimiyatga ega bo'lishi istiqbolidan tahdidlangan bo'lishi mumkin. Bu xurujlar, ongli yoki ongsiz bo'lsin, ayollarning martaba o'sishiga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin.

Ayollarning bugungi kundagi hokimiyat darajasi tasavvurga sig'masdek tuyulganiga ko'p vaqt bo'lgani yo'q. Ayollar harakati yuksalishidan oldin ayollar uchun teng huquqlar va imkoniyatlar mavjud emas edi. Odatda, ayollar turmush qurishlari, bolalarni tarbiyalashlari va barcha uy ishlarini boshqarishlari kutilgan. Agar ular ishlasa, odatda to'liqsiz ish kuni, ko'pincha malakasi past ishda ishlashardi. Ayollarning rollari haqidagi bu an'anaviy qarash ularning ish joyidagi salohiyatini sezilarli darajada chekladi.

Feministlar buni seksizm va ayollarning salohiyatini yo'qotish deb bilishdi va ular vaziyatni o'zgartirishga intilishdi. Garchi ba'zi odamlar, ham erkaklar, ham ayollar, hozir feminizmga salbiy nuqtai nazar bilan qarashlari mumkin bo'lsa-da, ayollar o'zlarining ish hayotidagi ko'plab yaxshilanishlar uchun feministlardan qarzdorlar. Ularning sa'y-harakatlarisiz, ijtimoiy yordam siyosatlari, ish o'rtoqlashish sxemalari va ish joyida ish haqining tengligi bo'lmas edi. Bu yutuqlar yanada adil jamiyat sari muhim qadamlarni ifodalaydi, garchi gender kamsitishni butunlay yo'q qilish uchun hali ko'p ish qilish kerak.
mock_data.translationC1:
Amerikaning taniqli moliya muassasasi hozirda federal hokimiyat organlari tomonidan boshlangan sud jarayoniga duch kelmoqda, buning asosiy sababi uning ayol ishchi kuchiga nisbatan tizimli kamsitishda ayblanishidir. Ayblovlar firmadagi ayollarning kasbiy o'sishi to'xtab qolganligi, erkak hamkasblariga nisbatan martaba pog'onasidan ko'tarilish imkoniyatlari kamroq ekanligi haqidagi da'volarga asoslangan. Bundan tashqari, ish haqi bo'yicha sezilarli tafovut mavjudligi, ayollarning maoshlari bir xil lavozimlardagi erkaklarning maoshlari bilan tenglikka erisha olmasligi da'vo qilinmoqda.

AQSh va boshqa ko'plab davlatlarda professional muhitda gender kamsitish qonun bilan taqiqlangan bo'lsa-da, nozik, ammo keng tarqalgan to'siqlar ayollarning malakasi va tajribasiga mos keladigan lavozimlarga ko'tarilishiga to'sqinlik qilishda davom etmoqda. Ko'pincha ayollar quyi lavozimlarda nisbatan tez ko'tarilishadi, lekin yuqori lavozimlar uchun kurashayotganda "shisha shift" deb ataladigan to'siqqa duch kelishadi. Natijada, turli sohalarda o'rta bo'g'in rahbarlari orasida ayollarning sezilarli darajada bo'lishiga qaramay, ularning yuqori darajadagi rahbarlik lavozimlaridagi vakilligi pastligicha qolmoqda, bu esa gender tengligi sohasidagi boshqa yutuqlarga zid keladi.

Bu nomutanosiblikning asosiy sabablari ko'p qirrali va murakkabdir. Ba'zilar buni lavozimga ko'tarish to'g'risida qaror qabul qiluvchilar orasida o'rnashib qolgan, garchi ko'pincha ongsiz bo'lsa ham, tarafkashlikka bog'lasa, boshqalar erkak rahbarlar orasida ma'lum darajada ishonchsizlik mavjudligi bu masalaga ta'sir qilishi mumkinligini taxmin qilishadi. Ayollarni muhim ta'sirga ega lavozimlarga ko'tarish ularning o'z kuchini yoki mavqeini qandaydir tarzda kamaytirishi mumkin degan xavotir muhim omil bo'lishi mumkin. Shuningdek, an'anaviy gender stereotiplari yetakchilik salohiyatini baholashga hali ham ortiqcha ta'sir ko'rsatadi, deb ta'kidlash mumkin.

Bugungi kunda ayollarning ta'sir darajasi bir necha o'n yillar oldin ko'pchilik uchun tasavvurga sig'mas bo'lib tuyulganini eslashga arziydi. Ikkinchi to'lqin feminist harakati ko'tarilishidan oldin ayollar uchun teng huquqlar va teng imkoniyatlar kabi tushunchalar jamiyat muhokamasida deyarli yo'q edi. Ayollardan, asosan, turmush qurish, bolalarni parvarish qilish va uy xo'jaligini boshqarishga ustuvor ahamiyat berishlari kutilgan. Agar ular pullik ish bilan shug'ullangan bo'lsa, u ko'pincha yarim kunlik, ko'pincha arzimas ishlar bilan cheklangan edi.

O'sha davrdagi feministlar keng tarqalgan seksizm va ayollarning imkoniyatlarini behuda sarflash deb hisoblagan narsalarga qarshi chiqib, mazmunli o'zgarishlarni amalga oshirishga boshchilik qilishdi. Feministlarga nisbatan zamonaviy munosabatlar xilma-xil bo'lsa-da, ba'zi shaxslar, erkaklar ham, ayollar ham o'z e'tirozlarini bildiradilar, ayollar o'zlarining professional hayotlaridagi ko'plab yaxshilanishlar uchun ushbu dastlabki faollarning sa'y-harakatlaridan qarzdor ekanliklari shubhasiz. Ularning himoyasisiz, ijobiy diskriminatsiya, moslashuvchan ish tartibi va ish haqi tengligi kabi tashabbuslar o'ziga xos ahamiyat kasb etmagan bo'lardi, shu bilan feminist harakatining ish joyida gender tengligi uchun davom etayotgan kurashdagi abadiy merosini ta'kidlaydi va xotirjamlik variant emasligini ko'rsatadi.
